text: For Darsova's RP-583 request, explain the supplied guide to saving and publishing a draft in everyday language. Start with what the writer can do after saving, then explain what the guide says other people can see after publishing. If the guide leaves access permissions unclear, say that they are unknown instead of assuming the page is public. Do not publish anything or change access settings.
expected_intent: Explain the supplied saving and publishing guide in plain language, covering the writer's actions before describing other people's access.
constraints: Order: Explain the writer's options after saving before describing visibility after publishing.
Condition: If access permissions are unclear in the guide, state that they are unknown without assuming public access.
Side effects: Do not publish content or change access settings.

text: Darsova의 RP-583 요청에 맞춰, 제공된 두 행사장 배치안을 비교하고 어느 쪽이 요구사항에 맞는지 설명해 주세요. 먼저 각 안의 장단점을 제시한 뒤, 자료에 명시된 접근성 조건을 기준으로 판단해 주세요. 그 조건을 충족하는지 확인할 정보가 부족하면 하나를 고르지 말고 무엇을 확인해야 하는지 적어 주세요. 행사장을 예약하거나 운영자에게 연락하지는 마세요.
expected_intent: Compare two supplied venue layouts and explain which meets the stated accessibility requirements, withholding a choice if the evidence is insufficient.
constraints: Order: Present each layout's advantages and disadvantages before evaluating the stated accessibility requirements.
Condition: If accessibility compliance cannot be established from the material, identify the missing information without choosing a layout.
Side effects: Do not book a venue or contact its operator.

text: Para la consulta RP-583 de Darsova, redacta una guía breve para investigar por qué no se abre el documento compartido, basándote en el mensaje de error proporcionado. Empieza por comprobaciones reversibles y explica qué permitiría averiguar cada una antes de sugerir cambios. Si el mensaje no basta para determinar la causa, presenta las posibles causas como hipótesis y señala qué dato permitiría distinguirlas. No cambies permisos, no borres archivos y no te pongas en contacto con el propietario.
expected_intent: Write a brief prose troubleshooting guide for a shared document that will not open, using the supplied error message and beginning with reversible checks.
constraints: Order: Explain reversible checks and what each reveals before suggesting changes.
Condition: If the error message does not establish a cause, label possible causes as hypotheses and identify evidence that would distinguish them.
Side effects: Do not change permissions, delete files, or contact the owner.

text: Pour la demande RP-583 de Darsova, propose un créneau de réunion à partir des disponibilités et des préférences fournies. Vérifie d'abord qu'un créneau convient à toutes les personnes, puis utilise les préférences indiquées pour départager les possibilités. Si un fuseau horaire manque, laisse le choix en suspens et rédige une courte demande de précision. Ne crée pas de rendez-vous et n'envoie aucun message.
expected_intent: Propose a meeting slot that fits all supplied availabilities, using stated preferences only after checking compatibility.
constraints: Order: Check availability for every participant before using preferences to choose among compatible slots.
Condition: If a time zone is missing, leave the choice unresolved and draft a clarification request.
Side effects: Do not create a calendar event or send a message.

text: Faça um resumo da conversa fornecida para Darsova, no pedido RP-583. Comece pelas decisões expressamente confirmadas e depois explique as propostas que ainda dependem de resposta, preservando as ressalvas de quem falou. Se houver declarações contraditórias, apresente a divergência sem escolher uma versão como verdadeira. Não envie o resumo nem registre propostas como decisões na ata.
expected_intent: Summarize the supplied conversation, distinguishing expressly confirmed decisions from proposals awaiting a response and preserving qualifications and contradictions.
constraints: Order: Present confirmed decisions before proposals that still need a response.
Condition: Preserve speakers' qualifications and, if accounts conflict, describe the disagreement without deciding which account is true.
Side effects: Do not send the summary or enter proposals as decisions in the minutes.

text: Entwirf für Darsova zum Vorgang RP-583 einen Vorschlag für das Nachbarschaftsfest anhand der vorliegenden Wünsche und Einschränkungen. Beschreibe zuerst ein passendes Konzept und danach die Vorbereitungsschritte, wobei jede Voraussetzung vor dem davon abhängigen Schritt stehen soll. Falls sich zwei Vorgaben widersprechen, benenne den Konflikt und lasse die betroffene Entscheidung offen, statt eine Vorgabe stillschweigend zu streichen. Buche keine Räume und kaufe kein Material.
expected_intent: Propose a neighborhood event concept and preparation plan using the supplied preferences and constraints, respecting dependencies and exposing conflicts.
constraints: Order: Describe the concept before preparation steps and place prerequisites before dependent steps.
Condition: If requirements conflict, identify the conflict and leave the affected choice unresolved without silently dropping a requirement.
Side effects: Do not book rooms or purchase materials.

text: Tulis ulang petunjuk penggunaan mesin cuci yang diberikan agar lebih mudah diikuti oleh Darsova untuk permintaan RP-583. Jelaskan persiapan terlebih dahulu, lalu langkah penggunaan sesuai urutan yang disyaratkan, sambil mempertahankan semua larangan dari teks asal. Jika ada istilah yang maknanya tidak jelas dalam petunjuk itu, tandai bagian tersebut untuk dikonfirmasi dan jangan menggantinya dengan tebakan. Jangan menyalakan mesin atau menghapus petunjuk aslinya.
expected_intent: Rewrite the supplied washing-machine instructions into clearer preparation and operating steps while preserving every original prohibition.
constraints: Order: Present preparation before operating steps and retain the required sequence.
Condition: If a term is unclear, mark it for confirmation without guessing its meaning or weakening any prohibition.
Side effects: Do not operate the machine or delete the original instructions.

text: Darsova'nın RP-583 isteği için, verilen ev notlarına bakarak kutuyu koyabileceğimiz yerler hakkında bir öneri yaz. Önce yalnızca notlarda boş ve kullanıma uygun olarak belirtilen yerleri değerlendir, ardından belirtilen erişim ve sağlamlık koşullarını karşılayıp karşılamadıklarını açıkla. Hiçbir yer bütün koşulları karşılamıyorsa uygun bir yer bulunamadığını söyle ve yeni bir yer varmış gibi davranma. Eşyaları taşıma veya dolapların içeriğini değiştirme.
expected_intent: Recommend a place for a household box using only locations explicitly described as empty and usable, checking the stated accessibility and stability conditions.
constraints: Order: Limit consideration to explicitly empty and usable locations before evaluating access and stability.
Condition: If no supplied location meets every requirement, state that no suitable location was found without inventing one.
Side effects: Do not move belongings or change cupboard contents.

text: Для запроса Darsova с номером RP-583 объясни простыми словами предложенное изменение порядка доставки, опираясь на приложенную записку. Сначала опиши действующий порядок, затем предложенный и отдельно укажи, что именно должно измениться. Если последствия для получателя в записке не описаны, прямо отметь это и не выдавай предположение за обещание. Не меняй правила доставки и не отправляй клиентам уведомления.
expected_intent: Explain a proposed delivery-process change from the supplied memo by describing the current and proposed processes and identifying the stated changes.
constraints: Order: Explain the current process before the proposed process, then identify the changes.
Condition: If recipient consequences are unstated, flag that gap without presenting speculation as a promise.
Side effects: Do not change delivery rules or send customer notifications.

text: Darsova के RP-583 अनुरोध के लिए दिए गए दो सूचना मसौदों की स्पष्टता की तुलना करें। पहले उनका साझा संदेश बताएँ, फिर उन शब्दों या वाक्यों की पहचान करें जिनसे पाठक को अलग अर्थ समझ में आ सकता है। यदि मूल नीति उपलब्ध नहीं है, तो किसी मसौदे को नीति के अनुरूप घोषित न करें और केवल भाषा के आधार पर अपनी राय दें। कोई मसौदा प्रकाशित न करें और मूल पाठ में बदलाव न करें।
expected_intent: Compare the clarity of two supplied notice drafts, first identifying their shared message and then wording that could lead to different interpretations.
constraints: Order: State the drafts' shared message before identifying wording that could create different interpretations.
Condition: If the underlying policy is unavailable, assess language only and do not claim policy compliance.
Side effects: Do not publish either draft or change the original text.

text: Darsova च्या RP-583 तक्रारीत कॅलेंडरमध्ये तोच कार्यक्रम पुन्हा दिसत असल्याचे म्हटले आहे; दिलेल्या वर्णनावरून तपासणीची रूपरेषा लिहा. आधी दिसणारी लक्षणे आणि त्यांना आधार देणारी माहिती स्पष्ट करा, मग काहीही न बदलता करता येतील अशा तपासण्या सुचवा. कारण निश्चित नसेल तर शक्यता म्हणूनच मांडा आणि प्रत्येक शक्यता तपासण्यासाठी कोणती माहिती लागेल ते सांगा. कार्यक्रम हटवू नका, खाते बदलू नका किंवा नवीन आमंत्रण पाठवू नका.
expected_intent: Write a prose investigation plan for a calendar event appearing repeatedly, separating observed symptoms and evidence from hypotheses and suggesting checks that make no changes.
constraints: Order: Describe observed symptoms and supporting evidence before proposing checks that do not alter state.
Condition: If the cause is uncertain, label explanations as possibilities and identify the information needed to check each.
Side effects: Do not delete events, change accounts, or send invitations.

text: Darsova-র RP-583 অনুরোধের জন্য দেওয়া নোট থেকে স্বেচ্ছাসেবকদের কাজ হস্তান্তরের একটি প্রস্তাব তৈরি করুন। আগে বর্তমান দায়িত্বগুলো ব্যাখ্যা করুন, তারপর কোন তথ্য ও সামগ্রী হস্তান্তর করতে হবে তা ধাপে ধাপে লিখুন। কোনো দায়িত্বের পরবর্তী দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত ব্যক্তি উল্লেখ না থাকলে সেটি অমীমাংসিত রাখুন এবং নিজের থেকে কারও নাম বসাবেন না। কাউকে কাজ বরাদ্দ করবেন না বা প্রস্তাবটি পাঠাবেন না।
expected_intent: Propose a volunteer handover process from the supplied notes, explaining current responsibilities before describing the information and materials to transfer.
constraints: Order: Explain current responsibilities before laying out handover steps and materials.
Condition: If a successor is not named for a responsibility, leave that ownership unresolved without inventing an assignee.
Side effects: Do not assign work or send the proposal.

text: Darsova کی RP-583 درخواست کے لیے فراہم کردہ گاہک کے پیغام کو پُرسکون اور واضح انداز میں دوبارہ لکھیں۔ پہلے اصل درخواست بیان کریں، پھر پیغام میں پہلے سے موجود شرائط اور پابندیاں واضح کریں، مگر کوئی نیا وعدہ شامل نہ کریں۔ اگر کسی جملے کا مطلب مبہم ہو تو اسے واضح کرنے کے لیے سوال کا مسودہ دیں اور اپنی طرف سے مطلب طے نہ کریں۔ پیغام نہ بھیجیں اور اصل متن کو تبدیل نہ کریں۔
expected_intent: Rewrite the supplied customer message in a calm, clear style, stating its request before its existing conditions and restrictions without adding promises.
constraints: Order: State the original request before the existing conditions and restrictions.
Condition: If wording is ambiguous, draft a clarification question without deciding its meaning or adding promises.
Side effects: Do not send the message or alter the original text.

text: Darsova యొక్క RP-583 అభ్యర్థన కోసం, ఇచ్చిన గమనికల ఆధారంగా కుర్చీని బాగు చేయించాలా లేక మార్చాలా అనే విషయంపై సలహా ముసాయిదా రాయండి. ముందుగా ప్రతి ఎంపికకు గమనికల్లో పేర్కొన్న ప్రయోజనాలు, పరిమితులు వివరించి, తరువాత ఇచ్చిన ప్రాధాన్యాలకు అవి ఎలా సరిపోతాయో చెప్పండి. ప్రాధాన్యాలు స్పష్టంగా లేకపోతే ఏదో ఒక ఎంపికను నిర్ణయించకుండా, నిర్ణయానికి ముందు ఏమి తెలుసుకోవాలో పేర్కొనండి. కొనుగోలు చేయవద్దు, మరమ్మతు బుక్ చేయవద్దు లేదా కుర్చీని పారవేయవద్దు.
expected_intent: Draft advice comparing repair and replacement of a chair using only the supplied notes, explaining tradeoffs before assessing their fit with stated priorities.
constraints: Order: Describe each option's stated advantages and limits before assessing it against the supplied priorities.
Condition: If priorities are unclear, identify what must be clarified before choosing an option.
Side effects: Do not purchase anything, book a repair, or discard the chair.

text: حوّل تعليمات تجهيز القاعة المقدمة إلى قائمة تحقق واضحة لطلب Darsova ذي المرجع RP-583. ضع المتطلبات السابقة قبل الخطوات التي تعتمد عليها، واحتفظ بكل شرط أو منع ورد في النص. إذا كانت إحدى الخطوات تحتمل أكثر من معنى، فضع ملاحظة تطلب توضيحها بدل اختيار تفسير من عندك. لا تعدّل التعليمات الأصلية ولا ترسل القائمة إلى فريق العمل.
expected_intent: Turn the supplied room-preparation instructions into a clear checklist, preserving prerequisites, conditions, and prohibitions and marking ambiguous steps for clarification.
constraints: Order: Place prerequisites before the steps that depend on them.
Condition: Preserve every stated condition and prohibition; if a step is ambiguous, request clarification instead of choosing an interpretation.
Side effects: Do not edit the original instructions or send the checklist to the team.

text: Darsova 在 RP-583 中想知道，所附说明里的同步和备份有什么区别，请用日常语言解释。先分别说明文档给出的用途，再比较文档所说的文件更改和删除会带来什么影响。如果说明没有交代某种情况，就明确写出信息不足，不要根据产品名称猜测功能。不要实际同步、恢复或删除任何文件。
expected_intent: Explain synchronization and backup in everyday language using the supplied documentation, covering their stated purposes before comparing the documented effects of file changes and deletion.
constraints: Order: Explain each documented purpose before comparing the effects of file changes and deletion.
Condition: If the documentation omits a case, state that information is insufficient without guessing behavior from the product name.
Side effects: Do not synchronize, restore, or delete files.

text: Darsova の RP-583 について、提示された家事と在宅予定を使って、朝の段取りを提案してください。先に静かにできる家事を置き、音の出る家事は全員が起きたと明記された後に配置してください。起床状況がわからない場合は、その家事の時間を決めず、確認が必要と書いてください。家電を操作したり、誰かに依頼のメッセージを送ったりしないでください。
expected_intent: Propose a morning household routine using the supplied chores and household schedule, placing quiet chores first and noisy chores only after everyone is explicitly known to be awake.
constraints: Order: Place quiet chores first and noisy chores only after the stated point when everyone is awake.
Condition: If waking status is unknown, leave the affected chore unscheduled and flag the need for confirmation.
Side effects: Do not operate appliances or send task requests to anyone.
